name: Hydrocarbon Processing news
notes: 102 topic feeds available. Add rss?topic=refining, diesel, gasoline, naphtha, hydrocracking, europe, asiapacific, middle-east, us. Syndicates Reuters energy wires.

name: Hydrocarbon Processing refining topic
notes: Narrower than the news feed. Use both and dedupe by URL.

name: Argus Media free news
notes: robots.txt allows news paths, sitemap at /sitemap.xml. Many articles are paywalled after the first paragraphs; headline and lede are enough for a lead. Check for an RSS link in page source on Day 3.

name: S&P Global Commodity Insights free news
notes: Headlines free, bodies mostly paywalled. Check robots.txt on Day 2.

name: Oil and Gas Journal
notes: robots.txt returned non-text to the fetcher. Check in a browser. Endeavor Business Media sites usually expose RSS at /rss.

name: TCEQ Air Emission Event Reports
notes: Decision needed on Day 2. If robots.txt disallows all bots, use data.texas.gov or a Public Information Request instead and write the decision record. Signal only, never counted as capacity offline until confirmed.

name: Louisiana DEQ incident reports
notes: Second regulator feed for the depth week. Check robots and page structure on Day 9.

name: EIA weekly inputs and utilisation
notes: Free key. Browse https://api.eia.gov/v2/petroleum/pnp without /data to confirm series names for gross inputs and utilisation by PADD. EIA publishes weekly on Wednesdays 10:30 ET. Fetched daily so a late release is caught. Cross-check for the note.

name: GDELT 2.0 GKG (English)
notes: Three zips every 15 minutes. Filter GKG organisations against refineries.csv aliases. Leads only; always fetch the source article.

name: GDELT 2.0 GKG (translated)
notes: The route to Chinese, Japanese, Korean local press. Same handling as gdelt_gkg.

name: Shell media releases
notes: Company statements are high confidence. Check for RSS on Day 3.

name: Valero newsroom
notes: Returned a client error to the fetcher, likely bot protection. Check in a browser; investor site may have RSS at investorvalero.com.

name: Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell (India)
notes: Monthly refinery throughput tables. Backfill and cross-check only.

name: Houston Chronicle energy
notes: Early local reporting on Gulf Coast upsets. Paywall after a few articles.

name: Port Arthur News
notes: Hyper-local, often first on Port Arthur and Beaumont incidents.

name: GDELT DOC 2.0 ArtList (English)
notes: Leads only. Article page fetched and stored. Publication time from the page. Check api.gdeltproject.org/robots.txt before clearing.
